SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME text,
(SELECT NVL(TDY_INTINCEXP,0) from (SELECT psv.TDY_INTINCEXP FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv WHERE psv.CDATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND psv.INV_AIM='999999' AND psv.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodIdOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by psv.CDATE desc ) where rownum=1 ) object FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PCI ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = PCI.PORTFOLIO_ID and PCI.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01'
WHERE A.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID != #{invTransPortf,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.MDATE >=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND A.VDATE <=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
AND ( A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) or A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )

select *from ( select fpv.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fpv.VALUATION valuation from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fpv.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID and fpv.FINPROD_TYPE2 = fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 where fpv.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fpv.VAL_DATE < to_date(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') order by fpv.VAL_DATE desc ) where rownum = 1
